_comment: Task 27 font-picker follow-up (8 Sept 2026). Two roles only - ui and monospace - matching Theme.qml's uiFont/monoFont. Fonts stay CONSTANT across themes (same principle as the 6 workspace colors, Design-Vision.md sec 2) - picking a font is a separate, orthogonal choice from picking a theme, not part of the theme bundle. Every package below confirmed installed and its exact fontconfig family name confirmed live via `fc-match` on the Yoga 6, 8 Sept 2026 - not assumed from a package name.

ui.role: General UI text - labels, buttons, body text across the dock/top bar/Settings/Command Centre

monospace.role: Terminal-style/code text - Keybinds display, Developer tab's event log and D-Bus tree, top-bar clock
